Plinko implementation reference
-------------------------------

Board layout and physics tuning were informed by the open-source project:
Anson Heung, AnsonH/plinko-game
https://github.com/AnsonH/plinko-game
Live demo: https://plinko-web-game.netlify.app/

This project uses Matter.js for the local physics simulation and adapts the
triangular pin-field layout, sloped guard-rail concept, pin spacing, and ball
friction approach to a five-bin, five-round birthday activity. The React UI,
£1–£5 scoring, and countdown-app integration are project-specific.

Physics engine bundled locally
------------------------------

Matter.js 0.19.0
https://github.com/liabru/matter-js
License: MIT (see MATTER-LICENSE.txt).
